agentiik  every namespace  alice   1 Runs   2 Workflows   3 Sharing  1 notifica…
Every key of this view

  q, ctrl+c    Quit, handing the screen back as it was
  ?            List every key, and close the list
  :            Open the command palette: commands, views, runs, workflows and
               namespaces
  1            The runs
  2            The workflows
  3            The sharing of a namespace or a workflow, read only
  ↑ ↓, k j     Move the selection over the runs
  enter        Open the run selected
  g            The graph of the run selected
  /            Filter the runs as you type: words against what is loaded, and
               namespace=, workflow=, state=, since= and until= asked of the
               installation
  esc          Clear the filter
  mouse        A click selects a row, a step, a port or a tab and focuses its
               pane, a second click opens it, the wheel scrolls what is under
               the pointer, a border between two panes is dragged to move it;
               shift and drag copy, as the terminal does


esc Close   q Quit
